identityHelp.differenceTitle: Contact details and submission: two separate actions
identityHelp.adminEntryMeaning: You can enter contact details received by phone or email. This correction is recorded in the history and preserves the review status; it does not submit the form on the sponsor’s behalf.
identityHelp.sponsorEntryMeaning: Through their private follow-up link, the sponsor clicks “Submit my information to the team”. A submission date is recorded and the dossier enters review. Review and publication authorization remain separate steps.
identityHelp.submissionRequired: To complete the Identity step, contact details must be complete and the sponsor must have submitted their form. Even if you fill in every field, the step still awaits this submission; you cannot validate it on their behalf.
identityHelp.coordinatesComplete: The company name and contact email are present.
identityHelp.coordinatesMissing: Enter the company name and contact email to complete the contact details. The public name, contact name and website are optional.
identityHelp.readonly: Your access is read-only. An operator or owner can correct these contact details.
identityHelp.submitted: The sponsor has submitted their form.
identityHelp.submissionPending: Waiting for the sponsor to submit their form.
identityHelp.submissionHelp: The sponsor must open their private follow-up link and click “Submit my information to the team”. An administrative correction of contact details does not replace this submission.
identityHelp.ownerHelp: If the sponsor has lost their link, ask an owner to resend follow-up access.

media.noGallery: No media workspace is linked to this dossier.
media.logoEmptyHelp: Add the logo to complete the profile. Uploading it does not publish the sponsorship.
media.photosEmptyHelp: Ask the sponsor to add a presentation photo through their follow-up form, then review its permissions and content here.
